comments.author: @ethanfletcher5369
comments.text:
I agree 100%. The rich continue increasing their salaries while the poor are expected to survive on low wages. But with all due respect, who is really to blame?

Every weekend there’s a fete, drinking, f*cking, and partying, while people continue complaining about the cost of living. Yet they allow the wealthy and those in power to keep benefiting off their backs.

Saint Lucia is undoubtedly beautiful, with some of the best entertainment and events. But outside of that, the cost of living is ridiculous. And mindsets  are low. The average person can barely afford groceries, bills, or even simple online purchases without having to wait another month or two. Meanwhile, others come here and enjoy our island more comfortably than we do.

A basic salary should cover necessities, allow people to enjoy their country, and even afford a vacation or two without financial stress.

I’m not even placing all the blame on those benefiting from the system. The people have the power to change things, but their mindset has become so conditioned and complacent that entertainment takes priority over progress.

Why not put the partying aside for a few years and focus on building a Saint Lucia where everyone can enjoy a decent standard of living?

The people have the power, but they’re too distracted to use it.

But that’s just my two cents. Who am I?
